messages:
Maya: quick RFC follow-up — proposing we move precision negotiation to the serving proxy layer. Rationale: keep runtime minimal (no per-request heavy logic), allow proxy to do dynamic routing, fast fallback, and metric tagging. Thoughts? :thinking:

Sam: this sounds promising. main worry: per-customer SLAs — do we keep quality_budget per-request or per-endpoint? per-request might be exploitable.

Nina: i'd bias per-endpoint (per-route) budget. easier to reason about and test. also we need a schema v2 for profile descriptors so proxies and runtimes can evolve independently. example: 
```yaml
precision_handshake:
  version: "v2"
  prefer: [fp8, int8, 4bit]
  quality_budget: 0.01
  fallback_policy: [int8, 4bit]
  profile_checksum: "sha256:..."
```

Oliver: nice. on the runtime side we can accept a compact header: 1-byte flags + profile-id (4 bytes). keeps wire overhead tiny. that means profile ids must be stable and discoverable. also require tracing tags: precision_requested, precision_actual, fallback_reason, deg_score.

Sam: +1 on tracing. can we define deg_score metric now (simple BLEU-ish or embedding-sim)? we should tie quality_budget to an eval harness.

Maya: agree. proposal: canary run that samples 200 canonical prompts + 50 edge cases; compute embedding-sim and fraction of samples with >threshold change. if above budget, fallback to safer profile.

Oliver: implementation note — fallback should be synchronous for safety-critical endpoints, but async for background jobs. runtime needs a fast path for synchronous fallback.

Nina: i'll start the schema draft (fields: id, version, prefer_order, quality_budget, checksum, compatibility_mask). will add compatibility notes for mixed fp8/int8 params.

Sam: tests: add unit tests to the proxy level to simulate negotiation and a small integration canary against staging runtime. acceptance: degradation < 1.5% on anchor eval.

Maya: action items: Nina -> schema v2 PR, Oliver -> prototype 1-byte header + checksum validation, Sam -> canary eval harness + gating, Maya -> rollout playbook + monitoring dashboard. need telemetry: per-request precision_requested, precision_actual, fallback_count, avg_deg_score.

ci-bot: perf run queued: job 4721. logs: https://ci.redwood/jobs/4721 :robot_face:

Oliver: one more thing — packaging: the quantized artifact should include profile_blob + profile_checksum so runtime can refuse incompatible blobs (avoid silent silent degradations).

Nina: adding profile_checksum to schema v2 now.

Maya: ok let's reconvene Wed 09:30. if no blockers i'll spin up the PR for proxy changes and the canary plan. :shipit:
